verdict.rationale: Poly is cloud storage with a desktop sync folder. That folder shows your files as a real folder in Finder or Explorer (poly-docs-23), and pinned content is downloaded eagerly and never evicted (poly-docs-47). Offline edits queue and sync later (poly-docs-49), and journal notes are plain Markdown files (poly-docs-12), so files on disk are readable without the app. However, the primary store is Poly's cloud: files download on demand by default, and nothing shows search, the agent, Mind or Flashback working offline. missing for 10: local-first (not cloud-primary) storage model, evidence that all features work fully offline, independent or hands-on corroboration of offline behavior.
